name: Device 2026-11-16
description: Xiaodong Xu (UW) structure: the bottom gate (graphite + hBN) is stacked first, Pt Hall-bar contacts are written on it, the TMD is dropped onto the Pt together with a thin hBN that carries the contact gates, and an hBN/graphite/hBN top gate is transferred last.

process: PC dry transfer: pick up the bottom hBN, then the graphite bottom gate; release onto the Si chip.
EBL + e-beam evaporation of the Pt Hall-bar contacts on the BG stack; contact-mode AFM cleaning (Pt RMS < 300 pm).   [UStack Stage 2: prepattern contacts]
Cut the TMD monolayer with an AFM tip (MoTe2: Ar glovebox, O2/H2O < 0.1 ppm). Pick up the thin hBN, half 1, rotate, half 2; release onto the BG stack and Pt.
Wash, AFM-clean; EBL + evaporation of the Pt contact gates and the Cr/Au connecting electrodes; AFM-clean again.   [UStack Stage 2: contact gates + leads]

notes: Contact-gate comb: 16 teeth, teeth top 7.16 µm, bottom 5.65 µm long from the tips (as short as puts the bus 0.5 µm from the TMD); bus 1.6 µm wide behind the teeth, leading out top +u 5 µm, bottom −u 5 µm; on Middle hBN (thin, contact-gate dielectric), ≥ 0.5 µm inside it. No source / drain in the stack: the left-most 2 top fingers and the right-most 2 bottom fingers are left ungated (source and drain).
2 outer fingers per column are left ungated (source / drain): with fewer, a tooth would leave the hBN.
The comb and its bus leads keep off the bubbles and cracks.

Bus led on to the far corners of Middle hBN (thin, contact-gate dielectric), top to (38.7, 18.8), 1.6 µm wide except where tight (down to 0.51 µm), bottom to (-22.1, -11.3), 1.6 µm wide except where tight (down to 1.36 µm) (0.5 µm inside it), so the electrodes can land outside the top hBN.
